name: inbox-agenda
description: Sign in with Google: browse important Gmail and let AI find the appointments hiding in your inbox, merged with Google Calendar. Next.js, hand-rolled OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, xAI Grok.

paragraphs: Sign in with Google to browse your important email, and let AI find the meetings, interviews, bookings and appointments hiding in your Gmail, merged with your Google Calendar, with the ones missing from your calendar highlighted.
features: 🔐 Sign in with Google: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE and state (CSRF protection), implemented by hand
👀 Read-only access to Gmail and Calendar: the app can't send, delete or change anything
🤖 AI extraction with xAI Grok: title, time (relative dates resolved), location, meeting link, organizer, status (scheduled / rescheduled / cancelled), confidence
🧩 Smart merge: matches email appointments against calendar events, collapses duplicate emails (confirmation + reminder), and flags "Not in your calendar"

📥 Gmail-style mail client (read-only): Inbox with Primary / Promotions / Social / Updates tabs, Starred, Important (Gmail's own ML-ranked importance), Sent, Drafts, All Mail, Spam and Trash, with unread counts, a…
